paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: Impact of batch size on decoding speed. Evaluated on LLaDA with a single NVIDIA H20; prefill length fixed at 100 tokens.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates how decoding throughput (tokens per second) varies with batch size for two decoding modes (“dKV-Cache-Decode” and “Origin”) across four sequence-length settings (L = 16, 32, 64, 128). The x-axis is labeled “Batch Size” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, and 120 (values extend to about 128). The y-axis is labeled “Token/s” on a linear scale from 0 up to 225, with regularly spaced tick marks every 25 tokens/s. For each L value, the dKV-Cache-Decode series is drawn as a solid line with markers, and the Origin series is drawn as a dashed line with the same color family and markers; L=16 is shown in light gray with square markers, L=32 in dark gray with circle markers, L=64 in red with upward-triangle markers, and L=128 in blue with upward-triangle markers. The light-gray L=16 dKV-Cache-Decode line increases across the shown batch sizes, reaching labeled values of 173.17 at batch size 32, 189.74 at 64, and 202.31 at 128, while the light-gray dashed Origin line lies lower and is labeled at 67.19 (batch size 32), 69.28 (64), and 69.62 (128). The dark-gray L=32 dKV-Cache-Decode line rises and then changes more gradually, with labeled values of 75.72 (batch size 32), 78.76 (64), and 81.18 (128), and the corresponding dashed Origin line is labeled at 34.53 (32), 34.95 (64), and 35.42 (128). The red L=64 dKV-Cache-Decode line increases and then flattens, with labeled points at 119.55 (batch size 32), 126.86 (64), and 130.58 (128), while the red dashed Origin line is labeled at 46.69 (32), 48.53 (64), and 48.93 (128). The blue L=128 dKV-Cache-Decode line climbs to higher throughput and then tapers, with labeled values of 159.24 (batch size 32), 175.95 (64), and 183.28 (128), and the blue dashed Origin line is labeled at 56.51 (32), 59.43 (64), and 59.71 (128).
